plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Sell SMH to remove underperforming semiconductor exposure.
Increase QQQI to 15% for income generation.
Trim CRWD, QQQ, and SPY to reduce concentration.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a cash buffer.
Expect lower volatility and modest growth.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions, building a cash buffer. Drawdowns should be minimal.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to small positions.
Trim SPY and QQQI to reduce concentration and income focus.
Trim CRWD to further reduce concentration.
Buy CRM as a new, high-scoring long setup.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.
balanced.read: This plan targets ~2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It trims leverage and concentration while adding a new, high-quality name. Expect a blend of stability and growth potential, with managed drawdowns.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to 6% each.
Add to CRWD, increasing its position to 15%.
Buy MSFT and NVDA as new, high-scoring long setups.
Trim QQQ to make room for new additions.
This plan leans into leverage and high-conviction names.
Expect higher potential returns and significantly larger drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by increasing leverage and concentrating in top-scoring setups. It accepts higher potential upside but also significantly larger drawdowns due to leverage and concentrated bets. Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can impact performance.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Sell high-beta single names CRWD and SMH to zero.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to reduce broad index exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.
Expect low volatility and consistent distributions, but NAV can fall.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly growth through distributions, prioritizing capital preservation. It eliminates volatile assets and maximizes exposure to income-generating ETFs like QQQI. While distributions are the goal, the Net Asset Value (NAV) can still decline in market downturns.
